parsed.english: There is a finitely generated ICC Kazhdan property (T) group Λ and a sequence Γ n of finitely generated ICC property (T) groups, whose group von Neumann algebras (with trace) are all isomorphic to each other and to that of Λ, yet no two of the groups Γ m, Γ n (m ≠ n) are isomorphic as groups, and none is isomorphic to Λ. Here 'not isomorphic' means that there is no multiplicative equivalence between them.
parsed.why_clearer: It replaces the bespoke wrapper GroupsIsomorphic by the standard Mathlib statement that no group isomorphism (≃*) exists, so the non-isomorphism clauses read directly.
